cap: Screening follows the organs a patient has. A cervix, kept by many transgender men, calls for cervical cancer screening, and testosterone makes samples less satisfactory; a neovagina has no cervix; breast tissue, even after mastectomy, keeps a role for mammography or examination; and the prostate stays after vaginoplasty, where estrogen lowers prostate-specific antigen. Every patient also needs infection tests by site, HPV vaccination and mental health screening.
